description: This file defines the interface for the CCSP Message Bus Service used in WiFi modules. It contains function declarations for engaging with the message bus, initializing, finalizing, sending signals, and registering components, serving as the header for the message bus interaction layer.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus for a component using specified configuration and path.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WiFi message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the WiFi message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check on the message bus status with user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the message bus with given priority and user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal indicating that a parameter value has changed.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_SendTransferCompleteSignal
methods.description: Signals that a transfer has been completed.

methods.name: CcspPandM_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming messages on the message bus path, acting as a DBus message handler.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers the object to the component registry with parameter array.

methods.name: waitConditionReady
methods.description: Waits until a specific condition related to the message bus is ready.
